policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the qere, which is what MACULA Hebrew projects; the alternative is the ketiv written in the Leningrad Codex.

decisions.evidence: ASV 'they hide themselves' renders the root צפן either way: qere יִצְפּוֹנוּ (qal) and ketiv יצפינו (hiphil) differ only in stem vocalization, and the English carries no marker of stem, object, or reflexivity that would exclude one. The only note on the verse (alternative_rendering, 'Or, Inasmuch as') concerns the following clause's conjunction, not this verb. Qere base fallback retained.
